in_sanskrit.name: सकेत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'saket' meaning 'fort, protection, security'. It is believed that a child named Saketha will be protected and secure in all aspects of life.

in_hindi.name: सकेता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सकेत (Saket) के तस्वीरी रूप से संज्ञा, जिसका अर्थ केसरी (Fort, protection, security) है।

in_tamil.name: சகேதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: சகேத (Saket) இழியலில் அறிவிப்பாற்றும் அன்புக்கல் இனியம். (A name derived from the Tamil word 'Saket' meaning 'protection, security'. It is believed that a child named Saketha will be protected and cherished.)

in_telugu.name: శకేథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శకేథ (Saket) సభ్యపైజోళోజీయ సూచ్చికేయ సౌభాయ్యేజీయ. (A name derived from the Telugu word 'Saket' meaning 'fort, protection, security'. It is believed that a child named Saketha will be protected and have a strong foundation.)

in_marathi.name: Saketha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saketha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Satya’, meaning truth, Saketha is a feminine name in Hindu mythology, representing the goddess of truth, virtue, and morality. She is also known as ‘Saketamata’, and is often invoked for truth and honesty.

She is also known as ‘Saketamata’, and is often invoked for truth and honesty.
